title: Y2K Polygon
description: Une esthétique nostalgique des jeux vidéo 3D de la fin des années 90 et du début des années 2000, caractérisée par une géométrie low-poly, des textures photographiques non filtrées et un éclairage rudimentaire. Le style présente des bords nets sans anticrénelage et une absence distincte de shaders avancés, créant un réalisme numérique brut et rigide.
description_en: A nostalgic late-90s/early-2000s 3D video game aesthetic characterized by low-poly geometry, unfiltered photographic textures, and rudimentary lighting. The style features stark, un-antialiased edges and a distinct lack of advanced shaders, resulting in a charmingly stiff and raw digital realism.
description_fr: Une esthétique nostalgique des jeux vidéo 3D de la fin des années 90 et du début des années 2000, caractérisée par une géométrie low-poly, des textures photographiques non filtrées et un éclairage rudimentaire. Le style présente des bords nets sans anticrénelage et une absence distincte de shaders avancés, créant un réalisme numérique brut et rigide.
prompt: Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Render this scene in the distinct visual style of a late-1990s or early-2000s 6th-generation console 3D video game. The geometry must be noticeably low-poly, with blocky, angular structures and visible polygonal seams on curved surfaces. Apply unfiltered, low-resolution photographic textures mapped directly onto the flat polygons, showing visible pixelation, bilinear filtering artifacts, and texture stretching. The lighting is rudimentary and baked-in: use flat, vertex-based illumination with stark, un-softened drop shadows and no ambient occlusion, global illumination, or advanced subsurface scattering. Colors should feature {{primary_color}} and {{accent_color}}, with {{secondary_color}} providing contrast, all appearing slightly washed out or muted by the virtual lighting engine. Edges must be completely un-antialiased, displaying distinct aliasing (jaggies) against the background. There is no depth of field; the background remains sharply in focus despite the low-resolution textures. The overall atmosphere is stiff, raw, and nostalgic, capturing the primitive realism of early 3D engines. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. 6th-gen console graphics, low-poly, un-antialiased, low-res photographic textures, vertex lighting, pixelated textures, blocky geometry, retro 3D engine, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.

background_prompt: A late-1990s 3D video game environment featuring low-poly architectural structures and blocky terrain. Surfaces are covered in low-resolution, unfiltered photographic textures showing noticeable pixelation and stretching. The scene is illuminated by flat, vertex-based lighting with hard, jagged shadows and no ambient occlusion. The color palette incorporates {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}} in a slightly muted, washed-out tone typical of early 3D rendering engines. All edges exhibit distinct aliasing and lack depth of field.

video.motion: Animation should feel slightly stiff and mechanical, mimicking early motion capture or keyframed 3D animation with limited interpolation. Background elements remain static, while interactive objects rotate on rigid axes.
video.camera: Camera movement should replicate a virtual tracking shot or a fixed third-person perspective, moving in linear, un-smoothed paths.
video.temporal_texture: Textures must exhibit severe 'texture swimming' or warping as the camera moves, and aliased edges must shimmer constantly.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth motion blur, high-framerate fluidity, depth of field, modern lighting models (PBR), and anti-aliasing.
